outcomes.gate_1e_property_alone: NOT as predicted: respond_before_slew 199/200 caught by the drawn property alone (clean 0/200); the miss is seed 49, reproduced locally. Cause, counted per example at that seed: of 100 examples 8 held a slew and a lag (not the 37 expected: Hypothesis's draw of one choice among eight is far from uniform; 33 held a lag and no slew), and none of the 8 told the lag's swap from the design's. The prediction's basis (counting the choices, as if drawn evenly) was wrong. Fix: each choice is a parameter of the test with its own 100 examples (predictions_ap1b_round5.json); at seed 49 locally the planted lag swap then fails 3 of the 8 cases (binding-lagged, partial-lagged, loose-lagged) and the explicit lag case, and the clean file passes all of them
